labeller_note: Read only batch-h4.json, vocabulary.md, the 13 workflow YAMLs and workflow_registry.py (claim tables). Results: one entry per distinct wanted result; when a request only names a workflow to run (no result words), the workflow name is quoted and linked to that workflow's main PRODUCES id with an 'implied' why; consultations that name no result get no results. Produces lists every id giving the words as asked (per-sample vs aggregate, regulator kinds, signed vs unsigned); an 'aggregate' output of a LIONESS job links both the LIONESS entry (which includes the aggregate) and the base workflow's network; very vague network wishes (M15, M43) list all fitting network ids. Empty produces carry near-miss or registry-wide ids. Settings use the workflow the phrase concerns (GIRAFFE, COBRA and CONDOR phrases are 'unregistered' since they expose no matching control); data declarations that BONOBO records as settings (gene rows, log2, centered) are labelled; 'estimate it' is value 'estimated'; conflicting or unconfirmable values are labelled 'unknown' or as both stated values. Output paths are neither settings nor data and are not labelled. Has/lacks slots follow the context: DRAGON-style tables fill omics_layer_1/2 in the order named; miRNA-target priors fill motif_file (PUMA's combined prior), the miRNA ID list fills mirna_file; clinical labels are 'none'. Source links are recorded only when the words explicitly tie a wanted result to data (from / for our / using / built on / feed into / relate X to Y), not for a plain 'run X on file'. Notes record unresolved user uncertainty and deliberate non-labels.
